about: One entry a measure of make perf: what it is, the median of make perf on 2026-10-13 (three runs a measure, ten launches, one idle run a state), the least and most of the medians of every session of that day that measured it, how many sessions that is, and the budget the median of three runs is judged against. A budget is the worst session's median plus a margin, never a single reading's: 10% for time inside a key, a delta or a launch and never less than 0.05 ms, 15% for a worst frame or a p95, a third or two frames for a count, 2% or 2 MB for memory, a quarter or 0.25 ms for time by the clock. Idle is held to rule 6 and not to the day: no second over 1%, a mean under 0.02% and under a wakeup every ten seconds. MacBook Air M5, macOS 27.0.1, built-in display at 60 Hz. A row marked ceiling is over rule 6's bar today: its budget keeps it from getting worse unseen and is no pass.
